summary: DRA_INTRADAY_SIGN_PERSISTENCE_BRANCH_CLOSE. The exact 52,608-row pre-2025 sealed H1 corpus, primary prior, frozen declarative runner, unchanged DRA V1 parent parity, within-day sign accounting and equal-capital assumptions passed. The primary 1.0 admission reduced Design drawdown from 29.530448% to 21.762553%, but Design total PnL fell from 90.77797326 to 48.18129282 USDT and terminal unrealized loss worsened. It failed every annual total-PnL fold and failed historical Validation: total PnL fell from 86.20298186 to 77.06168266 USDT, realized PnL fell from 89.41118307 to 77.06168266, drawdown rose from 7.121498% to 11.279654%, median/P90 holding rose from 182.5/1418.3h to 245.0/2783.0h, and annual total-PnL breadth was 0/5. The 0.8 neighbor improved Validation total by 1.85571819 USDT but failed its drawdown gate, holding path and annual breadth; the 1.2 neighbor lost heavily. The exact family is closed without choosing the observed neighbor, tuning, candidate creation or OOS access.
